destination.title: Horizon entropy, quantum information and cosmological descriptions
destination.question: How do specified gravitational and quantum models describe horizons, entropy and information, and what do their dynamics, consistency tests and cosmological applications establish under their own assumptions?
destination.summary: This proposed family spans several systems and frameworks without requiring a shared entropy interpretation, microscopic mechanism or Swampland premise. Public directions reuse existing questions across review batches. General conditioning, dynamical bounds, sensing and soliton-size questions retain explicit alternate access.

sources.title: Entropy bounds and dark energy

evidence.text: Can entropy bounds make quantum vacuum-energy corrections finite and naturally reproduce the reported dark-energy density while satisfying cosmological equation-of-state constraints? What follows if the resulting length dependence also applies to smaller systems?

sources.title: A Few words on entropy, thermodynamics, and horizons

evidence.text: Are proposed Bekenstein and holographic entropy bounds necessary for semiclassical black-hole thermodynamics, and how does observer-dependent entropy flux resolve apparent generalized-second-law violations?

sources.title: Information in black hole radiation

evidence.text: Can perturbative calculations exclude gradual information recovery in black-hole radiation if unitary evaporation encodes information in exponentially small corrections or widely distributed correlations?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Can low-curvature Hamiltonian evolution on nice slices describe an entire unitary evaporation? The reviewed paradox contrasts the entropy increase predicted by independent interior and exterior degrees of freedom with the shrinking information capacity assigned to the hole.

sources.title: Relative entropy and the Bekenstein bound

evidence.text: Can the Bekenstein bound receive an unambiguous flat-space QFT formulation using localized, vacuum-subtracted entropy and modular energy, and does that formulation follow from semiclassical generalized-second-law arguments without an additional physical principle?

sources.title: Generalized gravitational entropy

evidence.text: Can Euclidean gravitational entropy be defined without a circle-translation Killing symmetry, and can a gravitational replica construction explain why the entropy is given by a codimension-two minimal-surface area?

sources.title: Cool horizons for entangled black holes

evidence.text: How does entanglement determine Einstein–Rosen bridges and black-hole interiors, and does entanglement with a distant system require a firewall? The paper tests AMPS/AMPSS reasoning in two-sided black-hole models and proposes extensions to evaporating holes.

sources.title: Unitary S Matrices With Long-Range Correlations and the Quantum Black Hole

evidence.text: Can long-range correlations between incoming and outgoing black-hole states be incorporated into a unitary S matrix at intermediate evaporation stages, and what changes to causality and complementarity would this require?

sources.title: Jerusalem Lectures on Black Holes and Quantum Information

evidence.text: How can black-hole evaporation preserve quantum information while allowing a smooth experience for an infalling observer, and how do quantum information theory and holography sharpen this problem?

sources.title: Why the entropy of spacetime is independent of species of particles -- the species problem

evidence.text: How can Bekenstein–Hawking entropy remain independent of the number of radiated particle species if all those species contribute to a black-hole atmosphere? The authors offer a proposed resolution by identifying spacetime entropy with atmosphere entropy.

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Resonance

evidence.text: Can metastable de Sitter space receive a potentially rigorous quantum definition as a resonance in transition amplitudes between particular excited states of asymptotically supersymmetric flat vacua? The diagnostic is a pole in a spectral representation of such an amplitude.

sources.title: Spacetime has a “thickness”

evidence.text: If black-hole information returns in Hawking radiation and leading-order causality holds in gently curved spacetime, what can make an energetic infalling shell depart from semiclassical evolution before its information becomes trapped?

sources.title: Supersymmetric dS/CFT

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric Euclidean vector models define a well-behaved Hartle-Hawking wavefunction through dS/CFT, providing evidence for stable supersymmetric de Sitter space in higher-spin gravity?

sources.title: Black Shells, Dirac's Field and the species problem

evidence.text: Can a collapsing thin-shell description supply a physical near-horizon cutoff, reproduce Bekenstein–Hawking entropy from a Dirac thermal atmosphere, and remove the species dependence when scalar and spinor contributions are combined?

sources.title: Entropy, Entanglement and Swampland Bounds in DS/dS

evidence.text: DS/dS proposes that gravity in a D-dimensional de Sitter bulk is described by two cutoff CFTs coupled to gravity on a d = D − 1 de Sitter slice.

sources.title: The entropy of bulk quantum fields and the entanglement wedge of an evaporating black hole

evidence.text: Can bulk quantum entropy significantly displace quantum extremal surfaces during black-hole evaporation, and can the resulting entanglement wedge reproduce the Page curve and Hayden-Preskill information-recovery delay?

sources.title: Area Law Saturation of Entropy Bound from Perturbative Unitarity in Renormalizable Theories

evidence.text: Does saturation of information-storage bounds acquire an area-law form in nongravitational renormalizable field theories, and is this tied to the boundary of perturbative unitarity?

sources.title: de Sitter Black Holes, Schottky Peaks, and Continuous Heat Engines

evidence.text: Do ordinary positive-Λ black-hole thermodynamic systems exhibit Schottky-like specific-heat peaks, and can their two-temperature dynamics support continuous heat engines constrained by the second law?

sources.title: The Page curve of Hawking radiation from semiclassical geometry

evidence.text: Can semiclassical geometry directly produce the Page curve of Hawking radiation, without merely inferring it from purity of the combined black hole–radiation state, and what entropy prescription accounts for interior islands?

sources.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation

evidence.text: Can the gravitational replica path integral directly yield a radiation entropy compatible with unitarity and the island rule, without higher-dimensional holographic input?

sources.title: Entropy Bound and Unitarity of Scattering Amplitudes

evidence.text: How do area-law and inverse-coupling entropy bounds follow from scattering unitarity, how do they differ from the Bekenstein bound, and what characterizes objects saturating them?

sources.title: The entropy of Hawking radiation

evidence.text: How can gravitational fine-grained entropy methods compute Hawking-radiation entropy consistently with unitary evaporation, despite the growing entropy obtained from the semiclassical radiation state?

sources.title: Islands in cosmology

evidence.text: When can quantum extremal islands exist in general spacetimes, and can crunching cosmological regions be encoded in auxiliary systems or non-crunching regions?

sources.title: Quantum de Sitter horizon entropy from quasicanonical bulk, edge, sphere and topological string partition functions

evidence.text: How can exact quantum corrections to de Sitter horizon entropy be computed for general gravitational EFT spectra, organized into bulk and edge contributions, and used to constrain proposed microscopic entropies?

sources.title: Hints of gravitational ergodicity: Berry’s ensemble and the universality of the semi-classical Page curve

evidence.text: Can an ensemble-averaged semiclassical calculation recover a unitarity-compatible Page curve within a single unitary theory, with the ensemble representing epoch time averages rather than distinct microscopic theories?

sources.title: IR/UV mixing, towers of species and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: What entropy can an EFT assign to a finite region before gravitational restrictions invalidate its extensive state count? The baseline comparison uses the original fields and leaves tower entropy out.

sources.title: IR/UV mixing, towers of species and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Which AdS region makes an entropy comparison sensitive to the cosmological scale? The paper fixes the box radius at order the AdS radius, between locally flat small spheres and large spheres with comparable area-volume growth.

sources.title: Gravity and the crossed product

evidence.text: How do perturbative gravitational corrections change the emergent large-N algebra outside an eternal black hole, and permit a definition of black hole entropy?

sources.title: Page curve and symmetries

evidence.text: How do conserved charges and explicit charge violation modify Page curves and symmetry-resolved entropies in a random qubit evaporation model, and what conditional lessons might this provide about black-hole evaporation and symmetries?

sources.title: Logarithmic corrections, entanglement entropy, and UV cutoffs in de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: Can a conformal description of the cosmological horizon explain de Sitter entanglement entropy, its logarithmic corrections and UV regulator, and the proposed finite dimension of an observer's Hilbert space?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Replace a model-specific fluctuation analysis by the adiabatic time-shift sector of a spatial-diffeomorphism-invariant effective action. This isolates a necessary source of dangerous fluctuations without requiring a complete microscopic matter Lagrangian.

sources.title: Relative entropy and the Bekenstein bound

evidence.text: Regularize localization by tracing over the complement of V, then subtract the entropy and modular-energy expectation of the vacuum reduced to the identical region. Define the modular Hamiltonian through ρ0V=exp(−K)/tr exp(−K).

sources.title: Generalized gravitational entropy

evidence.text: Add and subtract an off-shell rounded-cone configuration. At first order in n−1, the equations of motion cancel the bulk variation with fixed outer boundary data; the remaining localized curvature contribution gives the area term. An equivalent calculation uses the inner boundary variation.

sources.title: Cool horizons for entangled black holes

evidence.text: Uses boundary time evolution to represent an early simple left operator A′ by a later scrambled operator A″ = exp(−2iHLt)A′exp(2iHLt). Bulk evolution relates A′ to an interior mode A; that relation depends on the bridge and on possible right-side disturbances.

sources.title: Unitary S Matrices With Long-Range Correlations and the Quantum Black Hole

evidence.text: Promote the interaction strength to a spacetime-dependent spurion g(x), split it into region-supported g1 and g2, and use functional Bogoliubov causality. Represent the boundary unitary by the Magnus form ω = exp(iφ), with Hermitian φ, allowing noncommuting operators.

sources.title: Jerusalem Lectures on Black Holes and Quantum Information

evidence.text: Uses Euclidean path integrals for vacuum states and gravitational thermodynamics, including integration over metrics and different topologies. Comparing thermal-AdS and AdS-Schwarzschild saddle actions gives the Hawking-Page exchange of dominance.

sources.title: Les Houches lectures on de Sitter space

evidence.text: Review classical de Sitter geometry, free scalar quantum field theory, horizon temperature and entropy as background for de Sitter quantum gravity; explain the conformal asymptotic symmetry underlying the proposed dS/CFT correspondence and derive suitable metric falloffs.

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: How do proposed quantum-gravity constraints interact with inflationary trajectories, dark-energy model building, modified gravity, and other cosmological systems? This passage maps the reviewed applications without providing the calculations needed to assess most of them.

sources.title: Graduated dark energy: Observational hints of a spontaneous sign switch in the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can graduated dark energy whose density crosses zero improve the historical ΛCDM fit to expansion data and alleviate H0 and Ly-α BAO tensions, motivating a sign-switching cosmological constant?

sources.title: Multi-field dark energy: Cosmic acceleration on a steep potential

evidence.text: Can dark energy remain dynamically active on a steep potential while its equation of state resembles a cosmological constant? The paper investigates whether turning in field space permits this behavior and whether fluctuations can distinguish it observationally.

sources.title: Coupled quintessence

evidence.text: Which accelerated cosmological trajectories exist for a scalar with an exponential potential and explicit linear matter coupling, and how do their CMB and matter perturbations constrain the coupling?

sources.title: Dark Energy from Structure: A Status Report

evidence.text: Can the effects assigned to Dark Energy arise from averaging ordinary inhomogeneous matter and geometry in Einstein gravity? The question includes whether an FLRW prior changes the interpretation of observations taken on different scales and at different epochs.

sources.title: Dark Energy from Structure: A Status Report

evidence.text: The setting isolates geometrical effects of averaging ordinary gravitating matter. It removes local pressure and rotational support so that positive regional acceleration, if obtained with zero cosmological constant, must come from the averaging terms.

sources.title: Dark Energy from Structure: A Status Report

evidence.text: Does an inhomogeneous universe evolve on average like an FLRW solution, and can structure-induced backreaction explain apparent Dark Energy within classical general relativity? This status report reviews the mechanism and strategies for establishing its quantitative and observational relevance.

sources.title: Moduli evolution in the presence of matter fields and flux compactification

evidence.text: The model couples the modulus controlling a runaway direction to a dynamical hidden matter sector that also participates in vacuum uplifting. It permits the cosmological role of the uplifting field to be studied instead of replacing that field by a fixed positive contribution.

sources.title: Limits from Weak Gravity Conjecture on Dark Energy Models

evidence.text: A decaying vacuum with physical EoS −1 cannot be separately conserved. The model supplies an interaction with dust and asks whether an effective canonical scalar description can satisfy the excursion criterion.

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: Can the Standard Model Higgs drive inflation and generate acceptable primordial perturbations through a non-minimal gravitational coupling, without introducing an additional inflaton particle?

sources.title: Graviton, ghost and instanton condensation on horizon scale of the Universe. Dark energy as a macroscopic effect of quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can coherent horizon-scale graviton–ghost condensates in self-consistent one-loop gravity explain cosmic acceleration and provide a dark-energy model without additional hypothetical fields?

sources.title: Quintessence dynamics with two scalar fields and mixed kinetic terms

evidence.text: How does a mixed kinetic term change the critical points, stability and dark-energy evolution of two scalar fields with additive or multiplicative exponential potentials, including whether the scalar equation of state can approach −1?

sources.title: Disentangling the $f(R)$ - Duality

evidence.text: How do decaying exponentials, rising exponentials, and monomial deformations of inflationary plateaus change their f(R) descriptions, including asymptotic powers, closed-form reconstructibility, and observable inflationary behavior?

sources.title: Interacting quintessence from a variational approach Part II: derivative couplings

evidence.text: Can a variational coupling linear in the scalar-field gradient produce covariant interacting quintessence models with matter-dominated intermediate evolution, late acceleration, and possible phantom-barrier crossing?

sources.title: Gauss-Bonnet Inflation

evidence.text: Can a scalar coupled to the Gauss–Bonnet invariant generate early de Sitter expansion and an exit without an imposed scalar self-potential, after neglecting the Einstein–Hilbert term in a proposed strong-gravity regime?

sources.title: A 2.4% Determination of the Local Value of the Hubble Constant

evidence.text: Can an improved geometric-distance–Cepheid–SN Ia ladder determine local H0 below 3% uncertainty, and test agreement with CMB-based predictions under the specified cosmological model?

sources.title: Mimetic gravity: a review of recent developments and applications to cosmology and astrophysics

evidence.text: How can mimetic gravity geometrically reproduce cosmological dark matter, inflation, late acceleration and galactic rotation curves, and what limits follow from stability and perturbations?

sources.title: Testing different approaches to quantum gravity with cosmology: An overview

evidence.text: How can cosmological observations test or constrain the reviewed quantum-gravity approaches, and what theoretical obstacles prevent reliable predictions?

sources.title: Model independent constraints on dark energy evolution from low-redshift observations

evidence.text: What can low-redshift background observations establish about expansion, ΛCDM tensions, dark-energy evolution and fluid stability when H(z) is reconstructed cosmographically without choosing a dark-energy or modified-gravity model?

sources.title: On the Cosmological Implications of the String Swampland

evidence.text: Can controlled quantum-gravity constructions realize a sufficiently small positive slope? Can improved equation-of-state, tensor and dark-sector observations sharpen the proposed restrictions or challenge their cosmological implementation?

sources.title: Warm DBI inflation with constant sound speed

evidence.text: Dissipation can maintain radiation during inflation and permit slow expansion on a steep potential. The paper assumes an equilibrated bath whose energy production changes slowly compared with dilution.

sources.title: Beyond $\Lambda $CDM with low and high redshift data: implications for dark energy

evidence.text: Can low-redshift expansion data be reconciled with Planck-constrained ΛCDM at higher redshift by reconstructing H(z), and what does that conditional reconstruction imply for dark-energy evolution and a possible negative cosmological constant?

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a derivative scalar support a de Sitter stress tensor while its background field evolves?

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can the reported string construction supply an exponential slope small enough for quintessence? Its small-slope regime requires at least 11542 internal dimensions.

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can transient motion between steep directions rescue a two-field potential whose shallowest asymptotic slope is too large? The displayed test includes matter, radiation, and initially stationary fields.

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can radiation production during inflation remove the need for an oscillatory reheating minimum while permitting inflation on a potential restricted by the Swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Quintessence Saves Higgs Instability

evidence.text: The model links dark-energy evolution to the Higgs potential through a common exponential factor. A negative past value of the Planck-normalized field φ increases the quartic boundary value without directly changing the other Standard Model interactions in the calculation.

sources.title: New Scalar Field Quartessence

evidence.text: Can one scalar dark component simultaneously support spatially clustered, particle-like dark matter and a nearly homogeneous dark-energy background at late times, rather than simply replacing an early matter phase with a late dark-energy phase?

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: How does continuous energy transfer from an inflaton to radiation change inflation compared with an effectively isolated inflaton? The bath can remain populated during accelerated expansion while potential energy dominates.

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: Can dissipation complement brane corrections or modified kinetic terms that already permit steeper potentials? The paper presents this as an additional route beyond its canonical quartic examples.

sources.title: Dark Energy from Structure: A Status Report

evidence.text: Riemannian volume averaging of scalars: ⟨Ψ⟩D=VD⁻¹∫D ΨJ d³X. The commutator ∂t⟨Ψ⟩D−⟨∂tΨ⟩D=⟨ΘΨ⟩D−⟨Θ⟩D⟨Ψ⟩D exposes correlations between local expansion and the averaged field without requiring perturbation theory.

sources.title: Moduli evolution in the presence of matter fields and flux compactification

evidence.text: Freeze local slopes and neglect expansion during conversion from stationary fields. Solve the conserved-energy system and use its limiting kinetic shares to initialize dilution. The reconstructed solution retains the velocity signs and the initial-energy factor in its hyperbolic-function time scale.

sources.title: Limits from Weak Gravity Conjecture on Dark Energy Models

evidence.text: Absorb the phenomenological interaction into an effective vacuum pressure, reconstruct a canonical background scalar from that effective stress tensor, and integrate its redshift derivative. Changing the decay law requires solving the interaction and background again.

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: The analysis uses Einstein-frame potential slow-roll parameters, the e-fold integral and the COBE normalization U/ε=(0.027MP)⁴. The authors state that the same inflationary results can be obtained in the Jordan frame.

sources.title: Graviton, ghost and instanton condensation on horizon scale of the Universe. Dark energy as a macroscopic effect of quantum gravity

evidence.text: Decompose fluctuations into rotational scalar, vector and tensor modes; impose state-vector constraints to eliminate scalar/vector contributions. Canonically quantize tensor gravitons and Grassmann ghosts, followed by the paper’s ghost bosonization procedure.

sources.title: Quintessence dynamics with two scalar fields and mixed kinetic terms

evidence.text: Rewrites the homogeneous equations as autonomous systems using Hubble-normalized field velocities and potential variables. Critical points are classified through existence conditions and Jacobian eigenvalues.

sources.title: Reconstructing Quintessence

evidence.text: Canonical quintessence replaces a constant dark-energy density with a minimally coupled scalar whose kinetic and potential energies determine cosmic expansion. A potential alone does not determine the history; scalar boundary conditions are also needed.

destinations.title: The model links dark-energy evolution to the Higgs potential through a common exponential factor. A negative past value of the Planck-normalized field φ increases the quartic boundary value without directly changing the other Standard Model interactions in the calculation.
Which accelerated cosmological trajectories exist for a scalar with an exponential potential and explicit linear matter coupling, and how do their CMB and matter perturbations constrain the coupling?
